title: Bus Duct / Busbar Trunking System Price in Pakistan 2026 — Sandwich Bus Duct, Plug-In, Rising Main, Feeder Bus Duct & LV Power Distribution Buyer Guide
summary_html: Pakistan's definitive 2026 guide to bus duct (busbar trunking system) pricing, sizing, and selection — covering sandwich bus duct 400A–4000A, plug-in tap-off systems, rising main vertical risers, IEC 61439-6 temperature derating at Pakistan ambient (45°C derating factor 0.94), PKR pricing per metre by current rating, bus duct vs copper cable cost crossover at 800A/30m, WAPDA SDO 6-point inspection requirements, 3-yearly joint re-torque rule for load-shedding environments, and 5 mistakes Pakistani contractors make with bus duct installations and their PKR repair costs.
